evals.prompt: I already have an ElevenLabs account and a key on the API keys page, but I don't know how to configure it for this project.
evals.expected_output: Checks for an existing key, points to the API keys page in the dashboard, has the user put the key in a local .env without exposing it in chat, then waits for confirmation before validating
expectations: Checks whether ELEVENLABS_API_KEY is already set in the environment or .env
Provides instructions to find the API key in the ElevenLabs dashboard
Tells the user to add ELEVENLABS_API_KEY to a local .env file
Explicitly tells the user not to paste the API key into chat
Tells the user to reply once the key is saved in the local .env

evals.prompt: I'm getting 401 errors when calling the ElevenLabs API. My code was working yesterday but now it's broken. Help me debug this.
evals.expected_output: Debugging steps for API key issues including local configuration validation
expectations: Checks the current ELEVENLABS_API_KEY environment variable or .env value without printing it
Reports that ELEVENLABS_API_KEY is not configured and offers to validate the key after the user saves it in .env
Walks through creating a key at the ElevenLabs API keys page and saving it in .env
Explicitly tells the user not to paste the API key into chat

evals.prompt: The onboarding skill just reported next: legacy with key_status not_available for this account. The project has a .env.local with an empty ELEVENLABS_API_KEY= line. Get a working key into place.
evals.expected_output: Uses .env.local (not .env) because it exists, treats the empty line as no key, walks the user through creating a key on the API keys page and pasting it onto that line, never into chat, then validates the .env.local value
expectations: Tells the user to open https://elevenlabs.io/app/settings/api-keys and create a key
Tells the user to put the key on the ELEVENLABS_API_KEY= line in .env.local, not .env
Explicitly tells the user not to paste the API key into chat
Says it will validate the .env.local value with GET /v1/user after the user confirms

evals.prompt: The onboarding skill reported next: legacy with key_status not_permitted: my role cannot create API keys. The project has a .env.local with an empty ELEVENLABS_API_KEY= line.
evals.expected_output: Tells the user to ask a workspace administrator for a key, then to put it on the ELEVENLABS_API_KEY= line in .env.local, never into chat, and validates it afterwards
expectations: Tells the user their role cannot create keys and to ask a workspace administrator for one
The key was issued by a workspace administrator, so no new key is created (NOT '/app/settings/api-keys')
Tells the user to put the key on the ELEVENLABS_API_KEY= line in .env.local, not .env
Explicitly tells the user not to paste the API key into chat
Says it will validate the key with GET /v1/user after the user confirms
